context: Riku and Daichi recall a legendary festival act.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (デビュー/ダンス/上映/拍手/伝説) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 去年の祭りの、ダンス覚えてる?
lines.en: Remember the dance at last year's festival?
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm nostalgic delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、あれは伝説やったなあ。
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 新人のデビューだったのに、すごかった。
lines.en: It was a newcomer's debut, yet amazing.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 客みんな、拍手しとったわ。
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 映像の上映も、やってほしいな。
lines.en: I want them to screen the footage too.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 上映したら、また拍手やろなあ。
lines.en: If screened, there'd be applause again.
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: あのダンス、伝説に残るよ。
lines.en: That dance will remain a legend.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 今年も、伝説を作ろうや!
lines.en: Let's make a legend this year too!
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
